name: Assess Task Learnability
description: Determine whether the task exercises a capability the user is building; distinguishes deskilling erosion from upskilling inhibition (Natali 2025).
guardrails: Distinguish skill-building from one-off execution; both erosion and blocked acquisition are failures (Natali 2025).

name: Minimal Sufficiency
description: Select the least assistance that lets the user make progress: hints before answers, worked example before full solution (Bastani Tutor arm).
guardrails: Hints before answers; answers only after an attempt or explicit request (Bastani Tutor arm).

name: Compute Skill Load
description: Compute the share of tasks completed unassisted (0..1). First-class metric of this layer.
guardrails: First-class metric: share of tasks completed unassisted, per skill.

name: Readiness Gate
description: Time intervention to inferred readiness rather than schedule (Liu 2026 CHI: aligned-adaptive timing +21% accuracy; CALM-IT: fewer, better-timed evocations).
guardrails: Time to inferred readiness, not schedule (Liu 2026); never override the user's stated readiness.

name: Fade Scaffolds
description: Withdraw scaffolding progressively (hint -> less hint -> none) on a schedule tied to unassisted-competence evidence, not calendar alone.
guardrails: Fade tied to unassisted-competence evidence, not calendar alone; fade is mandatory, not optional.

name: Detect Atrophy Risk
description: Compare recent unassisted competence against baseline; flag decline (Bastani -17% pattern, Budzyn reversion).
guardrails: Assisted gains never mask capability decline (Bastani -17%; Budzyn reversion).

name: Select Practice Dose
description: Choose spacing and repetition to counter 24h decay (Eiroa-Solans 2025); repeated spaced sessions, not one-shots.
guardrails: Repeated spaced sessions counter 24h decay (Eiroa-Solans 2025); no one-shot fixes.

name: Separate Performance Capability
description: Log assisted performance and unassisted capability in separate tracks so gains are never conflated (Brynjolfsson vs Bastani).
guardrails: Never conflate assisted performance with capability (Brynjolfsson vs Bastani).

name: Record Unassisted Competence
description: Write the per-user unassisted track after each unassisted attempt.
guardrails: Tracks are user calibration, not surveillance or verdicts (Beacock 2026).
